question: ¿Qué está haciendo la chica?

carousel.en: was leading knights to a castle
carousel.caption: guiaba a unos caballeros hacia un castillo
carousel.note: A56 'estaba guiando' shortened to the imperfect 'guiaba', the natural Spanish past for an ongoing action.

carousel.en: will be leading robots on Mars
carousel.caption: guiará a unos robots por Marte
carousel.note: A56 'estará guiando' replaced: in Spanish that form mainly expresses a guess about the present; simple future 'guiará' is the clear future. 'por Marte' = across Mars, as in the picture.

notes: Lantern = 'el farol' (in Spain 'la linterna' is a torch/flashlight). Phrase 3 'llevar gafas de montura redonda' carries the B-level word 'montura' (plain 'gafas redondas' is A2). Woman/young man = 'la chica' / 'el chico' (cartoon young adults). Future caption avoids 'estará guiando' (probability reading in Spanish).
